about.title: Complete Technology Solutions For Modern Businesses
about.text:
VStack Business Solutions helps businesses grow with complete digital and technology solutions. We build custom software, billing systems, POS solutions, websites, mobile applications, and provide complete hardware setups including computers, printers, CCTV, networking, and business equipment.

From software development to complete office technology setup, we provide everything your business needs — designed according to your requirements.

At VStack Business Solutions, we believe every business has unique needs. That's why we create customized solutions instead of one-size-fits-all products.

Whether you need a billing system for your shop, a complete POS setup, a business website, mobile application, office computers, security systems, or technical support — our team provides reliable solutions from idea to implementation.

cta.title: One Partner. Complete Business Technology.
cta.text: Stop searching for multiple providers. VStack Business Solutions handles your software, hardware, and digital needs under one roof.

demos.title: SaaS Landing Page
demos.description: Modern SaaS landing with hero, feature grid, pricing tiers, and animated CTAs.
demos.architectureNote: Component-based sections make it easy to add pages, A/B test blocks, and connect to a CMS or API later.

demos.title: Agency Portfolio
demos.description: Creative agency site with filterable case studies and hover-driven project cards.
highlights: Clean visual hierarchy for case studies
demos.architectureNote: Portfolio items can be driven from JSON or a headless CMS without redesigning the layout.

demos.title: E-commerce Storefront
demos.description: Product grid with quick-view drawer, cart badge animation, and checkout-ready layout.
demos.architectureNote: Catalog, cart, and checkout can plug into Shopify, WooCommerce, or a custom backend.

demos.title: Admin Dashboard
demos.description: Desktop-style admin panel with sidebar navigation, KPI cards, and data tables.
highlights: Native desktop window chrome and sidebar nav
KPI cards and sortable data tables
Role-based module layout ready for scale
demos.architectureNote: Modular nav and widget slots map cleanly to feature modules, permissions, and real-time data feeds.

demos.title: Desktop POS
demos.description: Point-of-sale desktop app with product grid, live cart, and billing workflow.
highlights: Fast product selection and cart updates
Clear totals and print-ready billing flow
Built for keyboard + touch counter use
demos.architectureNote: Cart and inventory layers can sync offline-first with cloud reporting and multi-store rollups.

demos.title: Fintech Wallet
demos.description: Mobile wallet UI with balance card, transactions, and bottom navigation.
highlights: Ready for secure API and KYC flows
demos.architectureNote: Screen flow separates auth, wallet, and payments — standard pattern for banking and fintech apps.

demos.title: Delivery Tracker
demos.description: Delivery app with map-style header, order timeline, and live status chips.
demos.architectureNote: Status events map to WebSocket or Firebase streams for live driver tracking.

demos.title: Micro-interactions
demos.description: Buttons, toggles, skeleton loaders, and toast notifications — polished motion design.
demos.architectureNote: Reusable motion tokens keep animations consistent across your entire product.

demos.title: Scroll Storytelling
demos.description: Scroll-driven reveals, parallax sections, and staggered content animations.
demos.architectureNote: Scroll sections are isolated components — easy to reorder for marketing campaigns.

demos.title: 3D Character Viewer
demos.description: Interactive 3D character model with orbit controls and idle animation loop.
highlights: Live GLB model with orbit and zoom
demos.architectureNote: GLB assets swap without code changes — ideal for game characters, mascots, and product configurators.

demos.title: Game Asset Showcase
demos.description: 3D prop model viewer with pipeline metadata — poly count, textures, and export info.
demos.architectureNote: Same viewer supports weapons, vehicles, and environment props for game and AR previews.
